name: utility-rule-coverage
sql: select count(*) rows,count(distinct building_id) configured_buildings,count(*) filter(where ceiling_amount is not null) absolute_rules,count(*) filter(where max_ratio_to_billed is not null) ratio_rules,count(*) filter(where building_id is null) global_rules from app_private.utility_ceiling_versions where organization_id='aaaa0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' and status='PUBLISHED'

name: utility-building-coverage
sql:
WITH utility AS (
SELECT ie.id,ie.organization_id,ie.building_id,ie.approval_status,ie.total_amount,ie.created_at,ua.utility_type,periods.period_month,periods.item_count,periods.period_month_count
FROM public.income_expenses ie LEFT JOIN public.building_utility_accounts ua ON ua.id=ie.utility_account_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(date_trunc('month',it.start_date)::date) period_month,count(*) item_count,count(distinct date_trunc('month',it.start_date)::date) period_month_count FROM public.income_expense_items it WHERE it.income_expense_id=ie.id) periods ON true
WHERE ie.organization_id='aaaa0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' AND ie.deleted_at IS NULL AND ie.system_source='utility.bill' AND ie.created_at>now()-interval '90 days'
), compared AS (
SELECT u.*,v.id ceiling_id,v.ceiling_amount,v.created_at rule_created_at,v.effective_from_month,v.max_ratio_to_billed,
app_private.utility_ceiling_check_v1(u.organization_id,u.building_id,u.utility_type,u.period_month,u.total_amount)->>'verdict' replay_verdict
FROM utility u LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM app_private.utility_ceiling_versions v
WHERE v.organization_id=u.organization_id AND v.status='PUBLISHED' AND v.utility_type=u.utility_type
AND v.effective_from_month<=u.period_month AND (v.building_id=u.building_id OR v.building_id IS NULL)
ORDER BY (v.building_id IS NOT NULL) DESC,v.effective_from_month DESC LIMIT 1) v ON true
) select count(distinct building_id) active_buildings,count(distinct (building_id,utility_type)) active_building_types,count(distinct building_id) filter(where exists(select 1 from app_private.utility_ceiling_versions v where v.organization_id=c.organization_id and v.status='PUBLISHED' and v.building_id=c.building_id)) buildings_with_any_rule,count(distinct (building_id,utility_type)) filter(where exists(select 1 from app_private.utility_ceiling_versions v where v.organization_id=c.organization_id and v.status='PUBLISHED' and v.building_id=c.building_id and v.utility_type=c.utility_type)) building_types_with_rule,count(*) vouchers,count(*) filter(where ceiling_id is not null) vouchers_rule_for_period,count(*) filter(where period_month_count<>1 or utility_type is null) unresolvable_period_or_type from compared c

WHERE ie.organization_id='aaaa0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' AND ie.deleted_at IS NULL AND ie.system_source='utility.bill' AND ie.created_at>now()-interval '90 days'
), compared AS (
SELECT u.*,v.id ceiling_id,v.ceiling_amount,v.created_at rule_created_at,v.effective_from_month,v.max_ratio_to_billed,
app_private.utility_ceiling_check_v1(u.organization_id,u.building_id,u.utility_type,u.period_month,u.total_amount)->>'verdict' replay_verdict

name: utility-safe-boundary-probes
sql: with v as (select * from app_private.utility_ceiling_versions where organization_id='aaaa0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' and status='PUBLISHED' and ceiling_amount is not null order by id limit 1) select 'equal' test,app_private.utility_ceiling_check_v1(organization_id,building_id,utility_type,effective_from_month,ceiling_amount)->>'verdict' verdict from v union all select 'over_one',app_private.utility_ceiling_check_v1(organization_id,building_id,utility_type,effective_from_month,ceiling_amount+1)->>'verdict' from v union all select 'before_effective',app_private.utility_ceiling_check_v1(organization_id,building_id,utility_type,(effective_from_month-interval '1 month')::date,ceiling_amount)->>'verdict' from v
